Title: Requester creates request with valid data
Steps:
1. Login as requester
2. Open Create Request
3. Enter valid data
4. Save draft
Expected Result: Draft is saved and request ID is generated

Title: Required fields block submission
Expected Result: System blocks submission and shows required field message

Title: Approver approves request
Steps:
1. Login as approver
2. Open request
3. Click Approve

Title: Rejection without reason is blocked
Steps:
1. Click Reject
2. Leave reason blank
3. Confirm

Title: Approved request becomes read-only
Steps:
1. Login as requester
2. Open approved request
3. Try editing amount

Title: List and detail status match
Steps:
1. Check request list
2. Open detail page
3. Compare status

Title: Approval fix does not break request creation
